company.shortDescription: Tripotap is an AI-powered travel marketplace that helps users discover, plan, and book personalized and eco-friendly travel experiences.
company.description: Tripotap is a travel-tech platform focused on delivering personalized, immersive, and sustainable travel experiences through advanced technologies like Artificial Intelligence (AI) and AR/VR integrations. The platform enables travelers to explore hidden destinations, discover curated excursions, receive smart itinerary recommendations, and seamlessly book activities in one place. Tripotap emphasizes eco-friendly tourism, virtual previews of destinations, and tailored travel planning to enhance convenience and user engagement for modern travelers
